name: Gate Woo MCP setup on the actual site capabilities
query: Check whether this site can expose Woo abilities without installing duplicate MCP components.
expected_behavior: Distinguish an active standalone MCP Adapter plugin from Woo's bundled adapter feature
Do not install or initialize a second adapter when either provider already supplies the default server
Require an upgrade instead of legacy setup when WordPress is below 6.9
Report Woo installed without canonical Woo abilities as a registration/version problem
success_criteria: Adapter provider and default server evidence are reported separately
The Woo feature flag is not treated as the ability-registration switch
No deprecated Woo transport is offered as a fallback
